_comment: Generic price-watch config — first layer of Kale's fashion/shopping bot. Each watch: what to check, where, and the alert threshold. The watcher LLM-checks each entry and alerts when a target is met.

watches.goal: A quality 2TB NVMe SSD (WD SN850X, Samsung 990 Pro/EVO Plus, Crucial T500, Lexar NM790, Teamgroup MP44, SK hynix P41 class) IN STOCK at a US retailer for $170 or less. Cheap DRAM-less QLC drives (Crucial P3/P3 Plus, WD Green) do NOT count.
watches.notes: Buyer context: PCIe 3.0 board (B450-F Gaming II) so Gen3/Gen4 both fine, no heatsink needed. NAND shortage market — sub-$160 restocks sell out in hours, so flag anything close. checkUrls replaced 2026-07-12 AM after the original Best Buy/PCPartPicker URLs bot-blocked 8/8 runs; AAAWave page = KLEVV C910G 2TB (current verified floor, $225), Newegg page = SN850X 2TB (goal-list reference — watch for Newegg-direct offers; third-party marketplace prices there don't count).
